# Psalm 109 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the choir director. A psalm of David. God of my praise, don't stay silent!

**2** Wicked, lying people have opened their mouths against me — they're speaking lies about me.

**3** They surround me with hateful words and attack me for no reason.

**4** I loved them, and they repay me with accusations. All I can do is pray.

**5** They give me evil in exchange for good, hatred in exchange for love.

**6** Put an evil man in charge of him, and let an accuser stand at his right side.

**7** When he goes to trial, let him be found guilty; let his prayers be counted as sins.

**8** Let his life be short; let someone else take his position.

**9** Let his children become orphans and his wife a widow.

**10** Let his children wander as beggars, driven out from the ruins of their home.

**11** Let creditors seize everything he owns; let strangers take everything he worked for.

**12** Let no one show him kindness; let no one take pity on his fatherless children.

**13** Let his descendants be wiped out; let their name disappear within a single generation.

**14** Let the LORD remember his father's sins; let his mother's sins never be erased.

**15** Let those sins remain before the LORD always, so he erases their family's memory from the earth.

**16** Because he never thought to show kindness. Instead, he hunted down the poor, the needy, and the brokenhearted — to destroy them.

**17** He loved to curse people — let the curse come back on him. He wanted nothing to do with blessing — so let blessing stay far away.

**18** He wore cursing like a coat — let it seep into him like water, soak into his bones like oil.

**19** Let it be like a robe he can never take off, like a belt permanently tied around him.

**20** Let this be how the LORD repays my accusers — everyone who speaks evil against me.

**21** But you, LORD my God — act on my behalf for the honor of your name! Because your faithful love is so good, rescue me!

**22** I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded inside me.

**23** I'm fading away like a shadow at dusk; I'm being brushed off like a bug.

**24** My knees are buckling from fasting; my body is wasting away.

**25** I've become a joke to them; when they see me, they shake their heads in contempt.

**26** Help me, LORD my God! Save me because of your faithful love!

**27** Let them know that your hand is behind this — that you, LORD, have acted.

**28** They can curse all they want — but you will bless. When they attack, they'll be humiliated, while your servant celebrates.

**29** Dress my accusers in disgrace; wrap them in shame like a cloak.

**30** I will thank the LORD loudly and publicly; I will praise him in front of the whole crowd.

**31** Because he stands at the side of the needy, ready to save them from those who condemn them.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **109:4**: 'All I can do is pray' — literally, 'I am prayer.' When everything else is stripped away, when people repay your love with hate, the only thing left is the act of bringing it all to God.

- **109:6-19**: This is the hardest psalm to read. The curses are brutal. But they represent the honest cry of someone who has been deeply, unfairly wronged. Rather than taking revenge, the psalmist hands the case to God — even if the requested verdict is severe.

— PNEUMA
